Before you arrive

What happens at a consultation

Nothing is booked on the day unless you want it to be. Most people leave with a plan and think about it.

01

Assessment

Skin or scalp history, current routine, previous treatments, and what you actually want to change.

02

Options

What will work, what will not, and what each path costs — including doing nothing.

03

Plan

A written plan and price. You take it away and decide in your own time.

All treatments require a consultation. Results vary between individuals. Consultation fees and treatment pricing are confirmed in writing before booking.
